description_expanded: ABOUT VIEWS FROM ABOVE: Views From Above, an exquisite 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom condo adorned with spectacular ocean vistas and expansive outdoor seating arrangements. Nestled in beautiful Watersound Beach Community that offers convenient access to a private pathway leading directly to the pristine white sands of the beach, this haven provides the ultimate luxury beach retreat for up to 8 guests. Upon arrival, guests are greeted by soaring ceiling-high windows that frame the breathtaking waters of the emerald coast and the picturesque shoreline. The open living room seamlessly flows out to a spacious balcony where the rhythmic sounds of the waves create a soothing ambiance. Adjacent to the living area, a fully equipped kitchen awaits, inviting you to relish in culinary creations while basking in the radiant glow of the sunset. The opulent master ensuite boasts a king bed with beachfront vistas and balcony access, accompanied by a lavish bathroom featuring dual closets, a spa tub, and a deluxe shower. Two additional guest bedrooms offer equally sumptuous accommodations, with one featuring another king bed, beach views, and balcony access, as well as a full bathroom. A separate wing houses a cozy retreat with 2 full beds over a king bed, thoughtfully designed for the utmost comfort and convenience. "Views From Above" promises an idyllic retreat for families seeking a quintessential Gulf Coast experience along the famed 30A. Whether indulging in a sun-kissed day at the beach, unwinding at one of Watersound's three expansive community pools, exploring the scenic cycling paths along 30A, or discovering the charming boutiques and culinary delights in the vicinity, this esteemed locale offers a myriad of activities to suit every preference. Secure your reservations today and embark on a journey to create everlasting memories with your loved ones in this unparalleled coastal haven. ABOUT THE AREA Located along Highway 30A, Watersound Beach is a picturesque coastal community on the Florida Emerald Coast. This beachside town is known for its white sandy beaches, serene atmosphere, and turquoise waters. It is the perfect tranquil retreat for visitors seeking natural beauty and relaxation. The wide, soft, powdery sand beach in this 30A community is ideal for sunset strolls, building sandcastles, and sunbathing. The Gulf of Mexico waters are suited for a variety of aquatic things to do, including swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, and paddleboarding. Thanks to the refreshing sea breeze and gentle waves, Watersound Beach is a peaceful haven for beachgoers. Watersound Beach is home to more than an incredible shoreline. Conservation areas, coastal cubes, and native vegetation surrounded the town, creating a sense of tranquility and seclusion. The area's architecture is inspired by traditional coastal design, combining charming beach cottages, pastel-colored homes, lush surroundings, and natural surroundings. During your Florida vacation to Watersound Beach, you can enjoy a wide assortment of amenities and activities. Bike along scenic 30A pathways, try your hand at watersports, or explore nearby Florida state parks. Dine at waterfront 30A restaurants and shop at boutique stores. Whether you're looking for things to do outdoors, cultural experiences, or simply a place to unwind and connect with nature, Watersound Beach provides a perfect setting for a memorable Florida beach vacation. BEACH ACCESS: * Private Beach Access for Watersound guest only. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Private Beach * 4 Robes included * 6 beach towels * Newly updated * Gulf views * Beach Front PARKING: * Free Parking up to 2 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * Additional pet fee * Guest do not have access to Watersound Beach Club ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
